qualitative.gate_2_reason: Societal / legislative acceptance risk (addictive or predatory model).
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (Rejected – G2 Essential Need). Lottomatica operates Italian online gaming, sports betting, and retail gaming machines (VLT/AWP). As an addictive and socially sensitive gambling business, it fails the Munger essential need standard and carries acute legislative, regulatory taxation, and concession renewal risks.
qualitative.evidence: Market leader in Italian online gaming (~31-32% share) and retail franchise networks under state concessions issued by the ADM. Generated >€2.25B in revenue with ~€2.1B net debt (~2.4x Net Debt/EBITDA). Operating under state licenses exposes the business to regulatory tax hikes, advertising bans, and tender renewal uncertainties, creating severe societal and legislative ruin risk.
